description: Read a Gmail inbox and draft or send mail through a Google account.
limitations: Send is default Off. Requires a platform-configured OAuth client. Not a calendar or Drive connector.
setup_hint: Connect with Google OAuth. Send stays off until the operator enables it.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Search Gmail threads with Gmail search syntax (from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:, is:unread). Returns thread ids, senders, subjects, dates, and snippets.

query.description: Gmail search query. Operators such as from:user and is:unread work.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read one Gmail thread by id, including message headers, attachments with their part ids, and text bodies.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one Gmail message by id, including headers, attachments with their part ids, and text body.

message_id.description: Message id from a thread or draft.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Download one attachment of a Gmail message into the agent workspace. get_message and get_thread list each attachment's part id. Pass an optional file_path in your home. The result is that path, not file bytes.

message_id.description: Message id, as get_thread lists it.

part_id.description: Attachment part id from get_message or get_thread.

file_path.description: Destination path in your home. Defaults to the attachment's filename in the workspace root.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List Gmail labels on the connected account (system and user labels).

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List Gmail drafts. Returns draft ids, message ids, recipients, and subjects.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft. Review it in Gmail before sending, or use send_message.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an email from the connected Gmail account. Default Off.
